newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese banks undervalued - Salomon report.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese banks undervalued - Salomon report.

text.p: Portuguese bank stocks are undervalued overall and some shares warrant a "strong buy" recommendation, according to a report by Salomon Brothers

It said that Banco Comercial Portugues (BCP), Banco Portugues de Investimento (BPI) and Banco Totta & Acores (BTA) were all in this category, offering a return on investment of some 40-55 percent in the next 12 months.

Banco Comercial Portugues (BCP) and Banco Portugues de Investimento (BPI) were undervalued not just because the value of their insurance businesses was "hidden", but because they had recently gone through restructurings following purchases.
